name: KiCad Project Manager
description: Review template updates, edit KiBot metadata, and apply company rules and stackup.
description_full: A native wxPython IPC companion for KiCad 9. Check project automation against a versioned local template, with colored file results and reviewed upgrades. Preserve metadata, workflow status, release-history variables and project documentation; add missing files through the same review. Edit metadata and authors, and select DRAFT/PRELIMINARY/CHECKED. Compare and apply a local standards catalog: company design rules stay in one marked block, and project exceptions outside that block are kept. Stackup updates cover copper, dielectrics, finish, and thickness. Close the PCB and schematic editors before applying standards. Preview changes, with local backups and conflict detection. Enable the KiCad API in Preferences → Plugins. Linux requires Python pip, venv, and distro-provided wxPython.
